key_points: TUKYSA breast cancer drug received approval, strengthening Pfizer's pipeline and revenue outlook
FDA expanded Tukysa's indication, providing additional market access and commercial momentum
Pfizer trading below 10x earnings while competitors like JNJ trade at higher multiples suggest undervaluation
Penicillin unit closure involves ~330 job cuts in Italy, representing a cost-cutting measure without immediate revenue impact
Pfizer continues its dividend streak with the 352nd consecutive payment, supporting income-focused investment thesis
